What I'm changing

Ideas I'd bring to your team

Starting points only. I'd refine them after learning your audience and goals.

For a hospital

  • Meet the doctorShort intro reels so patients see a friendly face before they visit.
  • Myth or factQuick health tips that answer questions people actually search for.
  • Awareness daysPosts for days like World Heart Day, planned a month ahead in a calendar.
  • What happens when you arriveA calm walkthrough of the visit, shot with patient consent.

For a business brand

  • Project spotlightsOne finished project per reel, from the brief to the result.
  • Thirty-second explainersHow the process works, in plain language for first-time clients.
  • The people behind the workTeam intros that build trust before the first call.
  • One-number monthly recapReview a single metric each month and decide what to repeat.
